title: Beach Therapy Vacation Rental
meta_description: Beach Therapy is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionBEACH THERAPYInlet Beach Community – Winston LaneHome Highlights5 bedrooms (Room configurations available under the “Room Details” tab)5 full baths, 2 half bathsSleeps up to 144,034 sq. ft.Two king master suites with marble showers and freestanding soaking tubsFlat-screen TVs in every bedroom (No cable service)Main living area equipped with Apple TV and NetflixFourth-floor den with large Apple TV, Netflix, oversized bean bags, sectional sofa, game table, wine fridge, bar sink, and balconyOutdoor seating with Gulf views on all four levels, including a private balcony off the third-floor king masterGround-level oceanside portico with ping-pong table, gas grill, bistro seating, and adjacent half bath next to the community poolDouble carport parking with elevator access + 1 additional parking space (3-car limit; only 1 parking pass)Six 26” adult bikes included seasonally (Not included Dec–Feb; additional rentals available)Community pool open year-round; heated during peak holiday periods only (March–Easter, Thanksgiving, Christmas & New Year’s)Beach Therapy – Luxury 30A Vacation Rental in Inlet BeachWelcome to Beach Therapy, a luxury 30A vacation home just steps from the Gulf of Mexico and minutes from Rosemary Beach. With 5 bedrooms, 5.5 bathrooms, and space for up to 14 guests, this designer retreat is ideal for families, multi-family groups, and friends seeking an upscale coastal getaway.A Home Designed for Relaxation & ComfortSpread across four levels with elevator access, Beach Therapy offers both space and privacy. Two king master suites feature spa-style bathrooms with soaking tubs and marble showers. A custom-built bunk room sleeps up to eight and includes individual built-in TVs for each bed. All bedrooms feature blackout drapes, Euro-plush mattresses, and smart TVs.Gulf Views & Prime Inlet Beach LocationEnjoy sweeping Gulf views from nearly every level of the home. You're just a short walk from the community pool and private beach access, with Inlet Beach’s peaceful charm and close proximity to Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach—all just minutes away.Entertaining Made EasyThe gourmet kitchen features Thermador appliances, double ovens, a 6-burner stove, wine fridge, and spacious island seating. Dine indoors or outside, then unwind in the fourth-floor den equipped with a smart TV, game table, and wet bar. The ground-level portico offers a grill, ping-pong table, and convenient half bath.Outdoor Living on 30AEnjoy Gulf breezes from three spacious balconies—perfect for morning coffee, afternoon relaxation, or sunset cocktails. Seasonal bikes are included for exploring the best of 30A.Amenities You’ll LovePrivate beach access just steps awayElevator to all levelsOutdoor entertaining area with grill and ping-pong tableHigh-speed Wi-Fi and streaming TVs throughout6 adult bikes (seasonal)Full laundry room and family-friendly floorplanWhether you're searching for a luxury 30A beach house, a tranquil Inlet Beach retreat, or the perfect multi-family vacation home, Beach Therapy delivers an unforgettable Gulf Coast escape.Community AmenitiesInlet Beach offers a true “local” feel from the moment you arrive. Enjoy the largest public beach access in South Walton, fish from the Gulf, explore new dining and shopping options, or bike to Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach for world-class shopping and dining.ParkingThis home includes three designated parking spaces total.The HOA strictly enforces parking rules—violations may result in towing at the guest’s expense.Overflow parking is not available.Reservation & Booking PoliciesThe cancelation policy and terms in the 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement override those from third-party booking sites (VRBO, HomeAway, VacationRentals.com).We cannot reimburse third-party booking service fees.We do not offer a 100% refund once a booking is processed. A 5% cancelation fee applies to all cancelations.No SmokingNo Pets Allowed (except certified service animals with advance notice and documentation)Published rates do not include taxes and fees50% deposit due at bookingRemaining balance due 60 days prior to arrivalExcept for a 5% cancelation fee, the initial 50% deposit is fully refundable when cancelation is received more than 60 days prior to arrivalOptional travel insurance available (must be purchased before final payment or at time of full payment)Exterior security camera present at parking areaCheck-in: 4:00 PM (CST) | Check-out: 10:00 AM (CST)Primary renter must be 25+ and remain on the premises for the entire stay
rooms_guidance: 3rd Floor King Master Suite: King - Gorgeous Gulf view from the bedroom, bathroom and balcony!
2nd Floor King Guest Master Suite: King
3rd Floor Queen Bedroom #2: Queen - Bathroom is also accessible from the hallway
4th Floor Bunk Room: 2 Sets of Bunk Beds (4 Twins), 2 Queen Beds - 2 sets of Twin bunks & 1 set of Queen bunks (4 Twins/2 Queen) Each with own TV!
